popia.title: Vhuifhinga hanu, Pfanelo dza khiine
popia.intro: Vulindlela i di-vhofha u tsireledza mafhungo anu. Ri tevhedza Mulayo wa u Tsireledza Mafhungo a muthu (POPIA).

who_we_are.title: 1. Ri vho-nnyi
who_we_are.content: Vulindlela ndi Mudzudzanyi a re na vhudifhinduleli. Mulangamadzulo wa mafhungo ashu a nga kwamiwa kha privacy@vulindlela.org.za.

what_we_collect.title: 2. Zwine ra zvi kuvhanganya
what_we_collect.content: Ri kuvhanganya fhedzi zwine ra zvi toda: dzina lanu, nomboro ya lutingo, fhethu hune na dzula, vhutsila, na luambo lune na lu takalela. A ri vhudzisi nomboro ya ID kana zwidodombedzwa zva bannga.

why_we_collect.title: 3. Ndi ngani ri tshi zvi kuvhanganya
why_we_collect.content: U itela u vha kwamanya na mikana, u khwathisedza vhaoli, na u vha tsireledza kha vhumbuluni (scams).

who_sees_it.title: 4. Ndi vho-nnyi vhane vha vhona mafhungo anu
who_sees_it.content: Vhaoli vha vhona fhedzi zwine na khetha u zvi govhela navho. A ri pfuki ri tshi rengisa mafhungo anu.

protection.title: 5. Ri zvi tsireledza hani
protection.content: Mafhungo anu o tsireledzwa nga khoutu (encrypted) nahone o vhewa fhethu ho tsireledzeaho.

rights.title: 6. Pfanelo dza khiine
rights.content: Vha nga vhona, u shandula, kana u thutha mafhungo anu tshifhinga tshinwe na tshinwe. Vha nga dovha vha vhilaela kha Information Regulator.

under_18.title: 7. Arali vha re fhasi ha minwaha ya 18
under_18.content: Vhashumisi vha re na minwaha ya 15–17 vha toda thendelo ya mubebi kana muingameli nga OTP.

camera.title: 8. Khamera na u shumisa zwanda
camera.content: Arali vha tshi shumisa zwanda (gestures), vidio i shumiwa kha tshishumiswa tshanu fhedzi nahone a i vheiwi.

popia.consent_processing: Ndi a tenda uri Vulindlela i shumise mafhungo anga u itela u tshimbidza akhautu yanga. (Zwi a todea)
popia.consent_employer: Ndi a tenda u govhela phurofaele yanga na vhaoli vho khwathisedzwaho. (Nga u tou di-funa)
popia.consent_alerts: Ndi a tenda u tanganedza ndivhadzo dza mikana. (Nga u tou di-funa)

shield.title: Tshivhoni tsha Vulindlela
shield.detector_desc: Nambathedzani vhudivhadzi ha mushumo afha u itela u lavhelesa zwiga zwa khombo.

accessibility.title: U swikeleleka
accessibility.personalize: Dzhiani tshifhinga u dzhia zwa khiine
accessibility.question: Vha toda tshishumiswa tshi tshi shuma nga ndila yo fhambanaho?
accessibility.blind: Ndi bofu / a ndi vhoni zwavhudi
accessibility.deaf: Ndi dzinga / a ndi pfi zwavhudi
accessibility.cognitive: Ndi na vhuleme ha u guda
